data.name: Kavishank
data.gender_notes: Kavishank is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kavishank is a name derived from Sanskrit, where 'Kavi' means 'Poet' and 'Shank' refers to 'God'. Hence, it represents the God of Poetry. The name Kavishank carries the meaning “God of Poetry” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kavishank usually hope their child will grow to embody god of poetry and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who creates rhythm in life.
data.etymology: Kavishank belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Poetry.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kavishank total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

It signifies a deep appreciation for the power of poetry and its ability to evoke emotions and inspire the soul. In Indian culture, poetry has been widely used as a medium of expressing deep spiritual and philosophical thoughts. The name also echoes the deep respect for the divine and the belief that the universe is filled with creativity and inspiration.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kavishank represents the divine poet within each one of us.
